verdict.rationale: As a code-first framework, Pydantic AI gives developers direct access to run message history, which they can persist or discard as they choose. Conversations can be serialized to and from JSON. Telemetry export to Logfire is optional and only happens if installed, configured and enabled, so data leaving the process is opt-in. Missing for 10: any documented retention policy or deletion controls (for message history, durable execution state, the AI Gateway, or Logfire-stored traces), and independent or hands-on corroboration of privacy controls.
